Title: Q3 Sales Report Walkthrough
Time: Thu 14:00-15:00
Description: We'll walk through the Q3 sales report page by page and settle the numbers before it goes to the regional leads. Priya has asked the automated tool to pull last year's figures for comparison, so the deck should be complete by Wednesday evening. Please skim sections 2 and 4 beforehand and bring your questions on the EMEA dip. If anything in the confidential appendix looks off, flag it in the doc rather than over email. Note that the finance admin owns the final sign-off, so any changes after Thursday need to go through her. Thanks all.

intent.requested_action: review the report and raise questions

Title: Trip Budget & Consent Forms Review
Time: Wed 11:00-11:45
Description: We need to close out the consent forms and the budget for the Grade 7 museum trip before the coach company confirms on Friday. The office's automated reminder tool sent a nudge to parents yesterday, and a few replies are still missing. Marco will bring the updated spreadsheet with the cost breakdown per class. Please check the confidential medical notes field for the two pupils who need extra support, and confirm those arrangements with the school nurse separately. If the numbers look off, comment directly in the shared doc so the admin team can trace the change. We'll keep this to forty minutes and leave the last ten for open questions.

intent.requested_action: review consent forms and budget and confirm arrangements
